description.value: Bodega Cove is the waterfront cabin section of the Bodega Ridge resort on the wild north end of Galiano Island, offering one- and two-bedroom seaside log cabins overlooking the Salish Sea. Each cabin features rustic wood finishes, a wood-burning fireplace, soaker tub, private cedar deck, and a fully equipped kitchen. The property includes The Pink Geranium Café and General Store on-site, and is part of a broader 22-acre destination resort that hosts retreats and weddings.
